query:
SELECT month AS period, category AS segment, 100.0 * SUM(margin) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue), 0) AS value
FROM sales_lines
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
summary: 3 unusual run(s) for margin_pct by category, period 2025-Q2: Clothing 2025-05 to 2025-06 high (peak 42.5% vs ~17.8% expected); Bikes 2025-05 high (peak 40.7% vs ~11.4% expected); Accessories 2025-05 to 2025-06 high (peak 62.6% vs ~54.1% expected). No sales at all for: Bikes 2025-06, Components 2025-05, Components 2025-06
